metadata.name: Caribbean Island - Comprehensive SES Template (MarineSABRES)
metadata.description: Comprehensive Social-Ecological System template for Caribbean islands focusing on major marine and coastal challenges including Sargassum invasions, coral reef degradation, chemical contamination, habitat loss, and overfishing

elements.label: Food security needs
elements.description: Population demand for fish and seafood as protein source and traditional diet component

elements.label: Economic development aspirations
elements.description: Need for economic growth, employment, and income generation in island economy

elements.label: Tourism demand
elements.description: Global demand for tropical beach vacations, diving, and eco-tourism experiences

elements.label: Agricultural production needs
elements.description: Demand for banana, sugarcane, and other tropical crop exports and local consumption

elements.label: Climate change adaptation needs
elements.description: Need to adapt to rising temperatures, sea level rise, and extreme weather events

elements.label: Housing and infrastructure needs
elements.description: Growing population demand for coastal housing, roads, and urban infrastructure

elements.label: Energy and waste management needs
elements.description: Population needs for electricity, water treatment, and waste disposal services

elements.label: Banana plantation agriculture (historical)
elements.description: Intensive banana cultivation using chlordecone pesticide (1972-1993) and ongoing agricultural practices

elements.label: Small-scale artisanal fishing
elements.description: Traditional and commercial fishing for reef fish, spiny lobster, queen conch, and other marine species

elements.label: Beach tourism and coastal recreation
elements.description: Beach resorts, hotels, restaurants, and recreational beach activities for tourists and residents

elements.label: Scuba diving and snorkeling
elements.description: Underwater tourism activities on coral reefs and marine sites

elements.label: Wastewater discharge
elements.description: Release of treated and untreated sewage from urban areas and tourism facilities into coastal waters

elements.label: Coastal urbanization and construction
elements.description: Building of hotels, housing, roads, and infrastructure in coastal zones; land reclamation

elements.label: Boat traffic and anchoring
elements.description: Commercial and recreational vessel operations, mooring, and anchoring near reefs and seagrass beds

elements.label: Dredging operations
elements.description: Harbor maintenance, navigation channel deepening, and coastal development dredging

elements.label: Sargassum cleanup and disposal
elements.description: Municipal efforts to collect, transport, and dispose of beached Sargassum seaweed

elements.label: Cruise ship and yacht tourism
elements.description: Cruise ship and yacht tourism

elements.label: Agricultural runoff
elements.description: Surface water flow from agricultural lands carrying nutrients, pesticides, and sediments to coastal areas

elements.label: Nutrient enrichment and eutrophication
elements.description: Excess nitrogen and phosphorus from wastewater, agricultural runoff, and distant sources (Amazon Basin, African rivers) fueling algal blooms

elements.label: Chlordecone and pesticide contamination
elements.description: Persistent legacy contamination from chlordecone pesticide (1972-1993) leaching from soils into rivers and coastal waters

elements.label: Heavy metal pollution
elements.description: Accumulation of heavy metals in marine sediments from industrial discharges and leaky sewage systems

elements.label: Sedimentation
elements.description: Suspended sediments from agricultural runoff, construction, and dredging smothering coral reefs and seagrass beds

elements.label: Elevated sea surface temperatures
elements.description: Rising ocean temperatures due to global climate change causing thermal stress to marine organisms

elements.label: Ocean acidification
elements.description: Increased CO₂ absorption lowering ocean pH and reducing carbonate availability for calcifying organisms

elements.label: Altered ocean circulation patterns
elements.description: Changes in currents (North Equatorial Recirculation Region) transporting Sargassum toward Caribbean

elements.label: Overfishing and fishing pressure
elements.description: Excessive removal of target species (reef fish, lobster, conch) exceeding sustainable levels

elements.label: Bycatch and incidental mortality
elements.description: Unintended capture and killing of non-target species including turtles, juvenile fish, and other marine life

elements.label: Physical damage to benthic habitats
elements.description: Direct mechanical destruction of coral reefs, seagrass beds, and mangroves from anchoring, dredging, trampling, and construction

elements.label: Habitat loss and fragmentation
elements.description: Conversion and removal of mangroves, wetlands, and coastal vegetation for development

elements.label: Introduction of invasive species
elements.description: Establishment of non-native species (e.g., lionfish) that disrupt native ecosystems

elements.label: Massive Sargassum seaweed accumulation
elements.description: Recurrent influxes (since 2011) of thick Sargassum mats washing ashore and accumulating in coastal waters
elements.indicator: Volume of Sargassum biomass on beaches (tons/year)

elements.label: Widespread coral bleaching and mortality
elements.description: Severe coral bleaching episodes (especially 2023) causing extensive coral death and reef degradation
elements.indicator: Percent coral cover and bleaching prevalence

elements.label: Contamination of marine sediments and biota
elements.description: Persistent chlordecone and heavy metal contamination in coastal sediments, fish, and seafood
elements.indicator: Chlordecone and heavy metal concentrations in sediment and tissue (μg/kg)

elements.label: Loss and degradation of mangrove forests
elements.description: Reduction in mangrove extent and health due to urbanization, pollution, and physical damage

elements.label: Seagrass meadow decline
elements.description: Loss of seagrass beds due to sedimentation, pollution, physical damage, and Sargassum smothering

elements.label: Depleted fish stocks
elements.description: Declining populations of key commercial species (spiny lobster, queen conch, reef fish) due to overfishing
elements.indicator: Catch per unit effort (CPUE), stock biomass estimates

elements.label: Disrupted ecological balance from invasive species
elements.description: Lionfish and other invasive species altering predator-prey dynamics and competing with native species

elements.label: Reduced water quality in coastal zones
elements.description: Elevated turbidity, nutrient levels, and pollutant concentrations in nearshore waters
elements.indicator: Water clarity (Secchi depth), nutrient concentrations, pollutant levels

r_extra.current_status: Degraded water quality in many areas

elements.label: Increased coastal erosion
elements.description: Accelerated shoreline erosion due to loss of protective coral reefs, mangroves, and seagrass beds

elements.label: Altered reef structural complexity
elements.description: Reduction in three-dimensional reef structure due to coral mortality, bioerosion, and lack of recovery
elements.indicator: Reef rugosity index, structural complexity score

elements.label: Loss of nursery and breeding habitat for fish
elements.description: Degradation of mangroves, seagrass beds, and coral reefs reduces essential habitat for juvenile fish and spawning grounds

r_extra.affected_species: Commercial fish, lobster, conch, reef fish

elements.label: Reduced fisheries productivity
elements.description: Declining fish stocks and degraded habitats result in lower catch rates and smaller fish sizes

elements.label: Contaminated seafood production
elements.description: Chlordecone and heavy metal contamination renders fish and shellfish unsafe for consumption in certain areas

elements.label: Degraded beach and coastal aesthetics
elements.description: Sargassum accumulation creates foul odors, unattractive appearance, and unpleasant beach conditions

elements.label: Reduced diving and snorkeling quality
elements.description: Coral bleaching, reef degradation, and reduced biodiversity diminish underwater tourism experiences

elements.label: Loss of natural coastal protection
elements.description: Degraded reefs, mangroves, and seagrass provide less buffering against waves, storm surge, and coastal flooding

r_extra.vulnerability: Increased flooding and storm damage risk

elements.label: Reduced carbon sequestration capacity
elements.description: Loss of mangroves, seagrass meadows, and living corals reduces blue carbon storage and CO₂ uptake

elements.label: Degraded water purification capacity
elements.description: Loss of filtering organisms (corals, sponges) and seagrass/mangrove systems reduces natural water quality maintenance

elements.label: Biodiversity loss
elements.description: Ecosystem degradation causes decline in endemic and endangered species (turtles, fish, corals, marine mammals)

elements.label: Public health hazards from Sargassum decomposition
elements.description: Hydrogen sulfide emissions cause respiratory irritation and health risks for coastal residents and workers

elements.label: Decline in tourism revenue
elements.description: Reduced tourist arrivals and expenditures due to degraded beaches, foul odors, bleached reefs, and poor water quality

r_extra.affected_population: Tourism workers, hotel operators, restaurants, tour guides

elements.label: Loss of fishing income and food security
elements.description: Reduced catches and fishing bans in contaminated zones lead to income loss and reduced access to traditional protein sources

r_extra.affected_population: Artisanal fishers, fishing families, coastal communities
r_extra.social_distribution: Most severe for small-scale fishers with limited alternatives
r_extra.food_security: Reduced access to affordable local seafood

elements.label: Public health risks from contaminated seafood
elements.description: Exposure to chlordecone and heavy metals through fish consumption poses carcinogenic and endocrine disruption risks

r_extra.affected_population: Seafood consumers, especially frequent fish eaters
r_extra.health_outcomes: Potential cancer, hormonal disorders, developmental effects

elements.label: Respiratory health impacts from Sargassum
elements.description: Hydrogen sulfide exposure causes respiratory irritation, headaches, and exacerbation of asthma

r_extra.health_outcomes: Respiratory symptoms, reduced quality of life during blooms

elements.label: Job losses in tourism and fishing sectors
elements.description: Economic decline in tourism and fisheries leads to unemployment and reduced job opportunities

r_extra.affected_population: Tourism workers, fishers, service industry employees

elements.label: Increased coastal flooding and property damage
elements.description: Loss of natural coastal protection increases vulnerability to storm surge, flooding, and erosion of homes and infrastructure

r_extra.economic_damage: Property losses, infrastructure damage, relocation costs
r_extra.climate_risk: Increasing with sea level rise and storm intensity

elements.label: Financial burden on municipalities
elements.description: Coastal cleanup, Sargassum disposal, and coastal protection measures strain municipal budgets

r_extra.affected_population: All residents (through taxes and reduced public services)
r_extra.annual_cost: Millions of euros for cleanup and management
r_extra.opportunity_cost: Diverted funds from other public services

elements.label: Loss of cultural heritage and traditional livelihoods
elements.description: Decline of traditional fishing culture, maritime knowledge, and cultural connection to marine resources

r_extra.affected_population: Traditional fishing communities, indigenous/local culture bearers
r_extra.cultural_outcomes: Erosion of traditional knowledge, loss of cultural practices
r_extra.intergenerational: Reduced transmission of maritime culture to youth

elements.label: Erosion of social trust and environmental justice concerns
elements.description: Legacy of chlordecone contamination creates distrust in government, food safety, and environmental management

r_extra.affected_population: All residents, especially historically affected agricultural workers
r_extra.social_outcomes: Reduced institutional trust, social conflict, justice demands

elements.label: Reduced quality of life and well-being
elements.description: Combined effects of environmental degradation, health risks, economic stress, and cultural loss reduce overall life satisfaction

r_extra.affected_population: All island residents, particularly coastal communities
r_extra.psychological_impact: Stress, anxiety about future, sense of loss

elements.label: Sargassum Management
elements.description: Integrated Sargassum management including early warning systems, emergency response, collection, recycling and valorization programs

elements.label: Marine Protected Areas
elements.description: Establishment, legislation and enforcement of Marine Protected Areas and no-take zones

elements.label: Habitat Restoration
elements.description: Coral reef, mangrove and seagrass restoration programs with protection ordinances and project grants

elements.label: Water Quality Management
elements.description: Wastewater treatment infrastructure, agricultural pollution control, and soil remediation programs

elements.label: Fisheries Management
elements.description: Sustainable fisheries management plans, quotas, seasonal closures, and community-based surveillance

elements.label: Seafood Safety
elements.description: Seafood contamination monitoring and fishing zone restrictions for contaminated areas

elements.label: Aquaculture & Fisher Support
elements.description: Aquaculture development, fisher compensation and livelihood transition support programs

elements.label: Coastal Planning
elements.description: Integrated coastal zone management, land-use planning, buffer zones and development regulations

elements.label: Invasive Species Control
elements.description: Invasive species removal programs (e.g., lionfish) with removal incentives

elements.label: Sustainable Tourism
elements.description: Sustainable tourism certification, best practices and mooring buoy installation programs

elements.label: Climate Adaptation
elements.description: Climate adaptation planning, coastal defense enhancement and national climate strategies

elements.label: Education & Awareness
elements.description: Public environmental education campaigns and curriculum development

elements.label: Regional Cooperation
elements.description: Regional Caribbean cooperation, knowledge sharing and international agreements

elements.label: Research & Monitoring
elements.description: Marine research programs, continuous monitoring, citizen science and coral reef research

elements.label: Livelihood Diversification
elements.description: Comprehensive skills training, vocational programs and business development support

elements.label: Ecotourism Development
elements.description: Community-based ecotourism development with licensing and benefit-sharing frameworks

elements.label: Blue Economy Innovation
elements.description: Blue economy development fund, entrepreneurship programs and business support

elements.label: Capacity Building
elements.description: Environmental management capacity building, training and certification programs
